पूर्वधारणा :
(i) पात्र चार्टर्ड अकाऊंटन्ट या जाहिरातीला प्रतिसाद देतील.
(ii) राष्ट्रीयीकृत बँकेत नियुक्ती हवी असलेले पात्र चार्टर्ड अकाऊंटन्ट पर्याप्त संख्येत उपलब्ध आहेत.
पर्यायी उत्तरे :

en.stem:
A statement and two presumptions from it are given below. Select an alternative about the presumption/presumptions which is/are implied in the given statement.
Statement : A nationalised bank had advertised in a national daily news paper that qualified candidates should apply for 100 posts of Chartered Accountants.
Preassumptions :
(i) The qualified Chartered Accountants will respond to this advertisement.
(ii) The qualified Chartered Accountants willing to be appointed in a nationalised bank are adequate in number.
Answer options :
options: Presumptions (i) and (ii) both are not implied.

तर पिवळ्या रंगाच्या शेजारचे चार रंग कोणते ?
